CoolGitOrg library intake

Each form below is generated from the issue form of the same name. Filling it in here only builds a link: submitting opens GitHub with your answers prefilled, and you file the issue there. The library publishes accepted requests to https://coolgitorg.github.io/issueops-library/; every item is open to everyone.

Submissions are paused (beta gate). You can still browse the library.

  • Library request — Render a template into the CoolGitOrg library and publish it on Pages.
  • Library borrow — Reserve an item's next-phase slot for 7 or 14 days.
  • Library return — Give back a borrowed item so someone else can take the next phase.
